whenToUse: News or magazine front pages and section fronts: a lead grid, then category modules in a main column.
Any feed mapped to NewsPost (a superset of BlogList's PostSummary).
avoidWhen: A calm blog index with few posts — use Blog list.
A single article — use Article layout.
a11y: Modules are sections named by their headings; card titles sit one level below.
Slider pages stay in the DOM (hidden); the counter is announced politely.
